Body.Content: API Management, the service that launched in public preview on May 12, 2014, is generally available. The Azure API Management REST API Reference automates API management operations and integrates API management with other services. Use Delegation to control user sign-in, sign-up, and product subscription management operations. Updates to the Developer Portal (via OAuth-enabled APIs) include support for voice recognition and the addition of 10 new languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, and Chinese. We also enabled full backup and restore of API Management services, improving disaster recovery and business continuity options for our customers. For more information, visit the API Management webpage. For a comprehensive look at pricing, visit the API Management Pricing Details webpage.
Body.Markdown:
API Management , the service that launched in public preview on May 12, 2014, is generally available. The Azure API Management REST API Reference automates API management operations and integrates API management with other services. Use Delegation to control user sign-in, sign-up, and product subscription management operations.

Updates to the Developer Portal (via OAuth-enabled APIs) include support for voice recognition and the addition of 10 new languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, and Chinese.

We also enabled full backup and restore of API Management services, improving disaster recovery and business continuity options for our customers.

For more information, visit the API Management webpage . For a comprehensive look at pricing, visit the API Management Pricing Details webpage.
